2:50 P.M. C/C FOR SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE. ALL PARTIES AND COUNSEL PRESENT. ARNOLD W. EVJE II, PRO TEM JUDGE. JOHN LEWIS, REPORTER. CASE SETTLED BY STIPULATED JUDGMENT IN FAVOR OF PLAINTIFF FOR RESTITUTION OF 1764 MISSION STREET. PLTF. WAIVES PAST DUE RENT FOR FEBRUARY, MARCH, AND APRIL, L994. EACH SIDE BEARS THEIR OWN COST AND ATTORNEY FEES. STAY EXECUTION ON STIPULATED JUDGMENT THROUGH 7/31/94 12:00 P.M. ON THE CONDITION THAT DEFENDANTS PRADOS AND JORDAN PAY RENT IN THE REDUCED SUM OF $800.00 PER MONTH ON THE FIFTH DAY OF EACH MONTH FOR MAY, JUNE AND JULY OF 1994. HABITABILITY CLAIMS TAKEN INTO CONSIDERATION. NO FURTHER STAYS FOR ANY REASON. THERE IS A MUTUAL RELEASE OF CLAIMS BY ALL PARTIES (CIVIL CODE 1542). PLTF. TO RE- TAIN SECURITY DEPOSIT. PERSONAL PROPERTY LEFT ON PREMISE BY DEFENDANTS AFTER 7/31/94 DEEMED ABANDONED. PLTF. TO PROVIDE POSITIVE REFERENCES TO POTENTIAL LANDLORDS.

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT PRADOS, RICK JORDAN, CHRISTOPHER THE RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES: 1764 MISSION STREET, SF, CA., STAYED UNTIL JUL-31-1994, SEE JUDGMENT FOR DETAILS.
